title: cross-functional-roadmap-sync-prep-may-2026
content:
Cross-functional roadmap alignment sync (Product + Eng + Applied ML) - Prep notes and follow-ups

Meeting: Roadmap alignment weekly (focus: Q2 milestones + model rollout cadence)
Proposed meeting date: 2026-03-04 10:00am PT (confirm availability)
Attendees (target): Aisha (Product), Marco (ServRuntime Eng), Sofia (Applied ML), Jamal (SRE), Priya (Console PM), 1-2 ENG leads (TBD)
Duration: 60 min

Objectives
- Align on Q2 roadmap priorities that affect serving/runtime work and evals: model variants, quantization, and rollout windows.
- Surface constraints from infra/SRE and prioritization trade-offs (latency SLO vs cost).
- Decide on gating criteria for canary -> full rollout for v2 model family.
- Identify dependencies and action owners for the 3-week rollout plan.

Prep notes / context for attendees
- Product asks: ship improved latency profile for chat endpoints without degrading quality; launch A/B test for v2 models by mid-April. Important features: function-calling stability and streaming support for v2.
- Eng (runtime) status: kernel selection upgrades done on branch runtime/pr-834, initial bench shows 8-12% token-latency improvement on A100 80GB with synthetic traces. Still flaky in long-context (>8k) regen paths. Need 1-2 more perf runs with realistic prefix distributions.
- Applied ML: v2 parameter-reduced variant (v2-small) shows ~2% drop on standard evals but 15-20% cost improvement with quantization. Concern: regression on domain-specific prompts (finance/legal). Need focused evals / QA prompt set.
- SRE: capacity for dedicated pools tight in EU region late April due to other commitments; suggest softening autoscale targets or routing policies.

Key agenda items / talking points
1) Quick sync (5m) - confirm objectives + success criteria for this meeting
2) Product priorities and release targets (10m) - Priya/Aisha: launch windows, key metrics for success (latency P50/P95, token cost delta, quality regressions)
3) Runtime readiness (15m) - Marco: kernel rollout status, known edge cases, performance variance, planned perf runs + dates
4) Applied ML eval plan (15m) - Sofia: targeted evals, QA prompt sets (finance/legal), thresholds for canary abort, and tooling for regression tracking
5) SRE / infra constraints (10m) - Jamal: capacity windows, fallback policies, suggested routing adjustments (region/capacity tier)
6) Action & owners (5m) - confirm next steps, owners, and due dates

Open questions to raise during meeting
- What is the minimum acceptable quality delta for v2-canary compared to v1 baseline? Product suggests <=1.5% aggregate drop across core prompt set; Applied ML thinks 2% might be realistic with quant. Need alignment.
- Can runtime guarantee KV cache behavior parity across quantized variants? Marco to confirm if there are known correctness edge cases.
- Should we prioritize EU capacity booking for Dedicated customers now or rely on routing to NA with cross-region fallback? SRE input required.
- Do we need an automated rollback trigger tied to eval regression thresholds or rely on manual aborts for canary?

Data / artifacts to bring to the meeting
- Perf runs: runtime/pr-834 bench results (Marco) - include real trace distribution and p50/p95 token latencies
- Eval dashboard: per-prompt quality deltas for v2-small vs v1 (Sofia) - highlight finance/legal subsets and hallucination rate
- Cost delta per-token estimates (Product + Finance) - rough numbers for public talking points
- Jira tickets: RD-4212 (v2 rollout plan), RD-4370 (EU capacity request)

Proposed gating criteria for canary -> rollout (draft)
- Acceptance: no >2% regression (avg) across core eval set; no more than 5% of prompts with >5% degradation.
- Performance: p95 latency must not exceed v1 p95 + 15% on production traffic distribution (or else limited to burst-only routing).
- Stability: no crashes or mem leaks observed in 24h of canary traffic; KV cache hit-rate within 3% of baseline.
- Ops readiness: rollback playbook documented and rehearsed; alerting thresholds wired into console and SLO dashboards.

Proposed rollout timeline (3-week plan)
Week 0 (this week): finalize eval set + perf runs; freeze feature list for canary. Owners: Sofia (eval set) - due 2026-03-05, Marco (perf runs) - due 2026-03-06
Week 1: internal canary (5% traffic, non-prod customers) - monitor 72h. Owners: Marco + Jamal.
Week 2: expand to 25% with A/B test and automated metric checks; if pass, Week 3 -> full rollout. Owner: Aisha/Priya for product-side gating, Marco for runtime scaling.

Risks & mitigation
- Risk: regressing on legal/finance prompts. Mitigation: create a focused QA pass that blocks canary if >X prompts regress. Sophia to produce list and expected thresholds.
- Risk: EU capacity shortage delaying rollout. Mitigation: enable region fallback and communicate latency tradeoff to impacted customers; SRE to confirm capacity plan for late-April.
- Risk: untested interactions with function-calling in v2. Mitigation: include function-calling tests in the eval harness and add synthetic tests for streaming + functions.

Action items (explicit)
- Sofia: finalize per-prompt eval dashboard, include finance/legal QC subset, publish link. Due 2026-03-05. (linked: Confluence XFN eval page)
- Marco: run 3 realistic perf runs with production trace (prefix distribution) on branch runtime/pr-834, upload results to Confluence and attach to RD-4212. Due 2026-03-06.
- Jamal: confirm EU Dedicated capacity window and propose fallback routing plan; include cost and latency impact estimate. Due 2026-03-08.
- Aisha/Priya: finalize product gating thresholds for canary (quality delta allowed) and confirm rollout comms plan. Due 2026-03-05.
- Eng lead (TBD): add automated regression checks to canary pipeline that aborts on eval threshold breaches; link to CI job. Due 2026-03-12.
- All: review rollback playbook and SLO alert thresholds before canary. Meeting to rehearse rollback steps w/ SRE in the canary start week.

Notes to self / things to mention in meeting
- Keep asking for concrete numbers (p50/p95, token-cost delta) — avoid fuzzy language.
- Emphasize customer impact stories (a couple of customers on Dedicated who requested lower latency in EU).
- Call out dependencies explicitly: runtime kernel rollout, applied-ml eval pass, capacity booking.
- If no clear agreement on gating thresholds, default to conservative: smaller canary and longer observation window.

Post-meeting follow-ups (template)
- Send meeting notes + decisions + explicit owners within 24h (Aisha)
- Update RD-4212 with final rollout plan and link CI perf artifacts (Marco)
- Create a short console dashboard view for the canary route (Priya)

Slack threads / links to reference during meeting
- #xfn-roadmap (thread pinned: v2-canary-discussion)
- Confluence: Cross-Functional Roadmap page (linked above)
- Jira: RD-4212, RD-4370

Scratchpad / quick ideas
- Consider a hybrid rollout: v2-small for streaming endpoints only initially (lower risk)
- Try per-customer routing for top 3 Dedicated customers first (to manage expectations)
- Add an eval sub-suite that measures hallucination rate specifically for legal prompts (Sofia to propose metric)

Draft notes for meeting opener (copyable)
"Thanks everyone for joining — goal today is to get alignment on the v2 rollout gates and timeline so we can schedule the canary. We have perf indications that runtime changes will improve latency, and applied ML sees cost/quality tradeoffs that look promising. Key decisions needed: acceptable quality delta for canary, whether we prioritize EU capacity booking now, and whether to automate rollback triggers. We'll capture owners and due dates at the end."

End of prep notes.
